bbd.text: Tae Jin is a wounded stranger who attacks Naiva in the rock ring, then faints after asking for Yasova Dragonclaw, and Yasova heals him despite suspecting a trap by Ojutai's broodling.
He explains that his master dreams of preserving the Spirit Dragon's story, which survives by oral tradition after Ojutai destroyed the records, and recites the words of Ugin to prove it.
An Ojutai broodling then appears, and its aven interpreter sentences him to die by ice for sacrilege.

m19.text: As the Ojutai broodling prepares to kill Tae Jin, Yasova secretly signals the hunters to kill, and Baishya, Naiva and Yasova stop the broodling and its aven interpreter.
Yasova decides to go on to Ugin's grave and asks Tae Jin to continue Ugin's story, and when an Atarka broodling attacks the camp he conjures a ghostly blade and slashes open its belly.

Yasova identifies his dragon mark as that of a ghostfire warrior, and Tae Jin explains that his mother was a scribe of Shu Yun who survived Ojutai's purge and that his master taught him the ghostfire blade.

When Atarka forces the party to follow her, she agrees to hear a story while she feasts, and afterward she declares there is only one law, to eat, and spares him, so Yasova asks him to stay and recite Ugin's story to Fec so it can be carved.
